description: Verify that the DUT rate-limit persists across multiple windows: post-silence Probe targets a fresh LL, and a single conflict puts the DUT back into RATE_LIMIT_INTERVAL silence (RFC 3927 §2.2.1, MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
_14 covers the first rate-limit silence; _15 extends it to the next cycle. After the first RATE_LIMIT_INTERVAL elapses, the DUT may try again BUT (a) on a fresh LL it has not used before, and (b) any single conflict re-arms the silence window. This case asserts both halves.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (fast-conflict envelope, rate_limit_interval = 3 s)

2. Force 10 conflicts (same as _14) → DUT enters first rate-limit silence (must NOT emit during this window).

3. After silence_1 elapses:
   • DUT → wire: ARP Probe with a NEW LL (must differ from any previously used LL)
   • Tester → DUT: 1 conflict ARP Request claiming this new LL

4. Observation (second rate-limit silence window):
   • DUT must NOT emit any ARP for the duration of RATE_LIMIT_INTERVAL

[Pass condition]
10-conflict cycle + post-silence Probe with fresh LL + single conflict + second silence observed clean.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_initial_probe — DUT did not emit any initial ARP Probe within the deadline
• Fail_conflicts_incomplete — DUT did not re-probe through MAX_CONFLICTS = 10
• Fail_cycle_repeat — DUT re-probed with a previously used LL during the 10-conflict cycle
• Fail_emitted_during_silence_1 — DUT emitted an ARP during the FIRST rate-limit silence
• Fail_no_post_silence_probe — DUT did not re-probe after the first silence ended
• Fail_post_silence_repeat — Post-silence Probe targets the SAME LL as before (must be fresh)
• Fail_emitted_during_silence_2 — DUT emitted an ARP during the SECOND rate-limit silence

verdicts.Pass: DUT rate-limit persisted across windows with fresh LL — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_initial_probe: DUT did not emit any initial ARP Probe within the deadline
verdicts.Fail_conflicts_incomplete: DUT did not re-probe through MAX_CONFLICTS = 10
verdicts.Fail_cycle_repeat: DUT re-probed with a stale Link-Local during the 10-conflict cycle
verdicts.Fail_emitted_during_silence_1: DUT emitted an ARP during the first rate-limit silence
verdicts.Fail_no_post_silence_probe: DUT did not re-probe after the first rate-limit silence ended
verdicts.Fail_post_silence_repeat: Post-silence Probe targets the same LL as before
verdicts.Fail_emitted_during_silence_2: DUT emitted an ARP during the second rate-limit silence
